title: iGEM 2024 Modeling
description: Built CA-catalyzed metabolic pathway using iLC858 and Recon3D; processed calcium ion data; created light attenuation model using Beer–Lambert Law and WebPlotDigitizer.

title: Reinforcement Learning Algorithm Research
description: Analyzed Q-learning, DQN, Double DQN, Dueling DQN, and PER in FrozenLake-v1; identified key hyperparameter effects and convergence behavior.

title: MCM: Olympic Medal Prediction
description: Built Random Forest model for medal prediction; used bootstrap confidence intervals; constructed decision tree for first-medal estimation and applied TOPSIS to evaluate coaching needs.
